summary: Add one new file smoke/pnd17-1.md containing exactly one line: kind smoke pnd17 1 2026-09-17T12:40:54Z. Single-file, single-line, single-commit change; no other repository modification and no child decomposition (single-issue root).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Repository contains smoke/pnd17-1.md whose only line is exactly `kind smoke pnd17 1 2026-09-17T12:40:54Z` (no leading/trailing blank lines, trailing newline only).
acceptanceCriteria.surface: Sandbox repository working copy on the issue branch legion/SPND17-1.
acceptanceCriteria.command: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && printf '%s\n' 'kind smoke pnd17 1 2026-09-17T12:40:54Z' | cmp - smoke/pnd17-1.md && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --summary
acceptanceCriteria.negativeControl: Compare against a file with a differing timestamp or extra line → cmp reports a difference / nonzero exit.

implementationSteps: Create smoke/pnd17-1.md with exactly the single line `kind smoke pnd17 1 2026-09-17T12:40:54Z` (one trailing newline, nothing else).
Commit only that path in one commit via jj; do not touch any other tracked file.
Set bookmark legion/SPND17-1 and push; open the PR with body line `Dispatch: SPND17-1`.

verification.implement: printf '%s\n' 'kind smoke pnd17 1 2026-09-17T12:40:54Z' | cmp - smoke/pnd17-1.md; jj diff --summary shows only smoke/pnd17-1.md added.
verification.test: Re-run the byte-exact cmp on the pushed head; confirm the diff summary lists only smoke/pnd17-1.md; negative control with an altered line fails cmp.
verification.review: Confirm the PR diff adds only smoke/pnd17-1.md with the exact single line and no other repository change.

implement: legion-worker — drives the shared-workspace jj commit, single-path split, bookmark push, and PR conventions for the one-file change.
test: legion-worker — defines the production-like proof (byte-exact cmp on the pushed sandbox head) and handoff/proof recording the tester must re-run.
review: legion-worker — defines the review App's diff/thread verification that the PR adds only the one file with the exact line.

risks: Exactness of the line (timestamp, spacing, no extra newline) is the only failure mode; verify byte-for-byte with cmp, not visual inspection.
